method: Start temperature at the scheduled start from the reviewed weather rows, one value per edition (editions with at least 100 finishes), in the 10 races with eleven or more such editions: each race's warmest minus its coolest morning, as a multiple of the gap between the coolest and the warmest race's median morning. Races are grouped by race name, so a city that changed race counts as two. These are mostly spring and autumn races in temperate cities. Over the 17 races with five or more editions, differences between years of the same race hold 75% of the variance of start temperature.
